map.title: Sector {{n}} · {{name}}
map.previewHole: Black hole: go around, or ride the wormhole

event.title: Signal
event.quiet: The sector holds its breath. Nothing stirs.
event.speaker: — {{name}}

anomaly.title: Anomaly
anomaly.failed: Not yet — reroll or roll anew
anomaly.rerollHint: Pick up to {{n}} dice to reroll
anomaly.interferenceWarn: Leave again and Resonance Interference begins.

rule.noWaste: No charge spilled past the cap

anomaly.entryLeaveNote: Walking away counts as unsolved and feeds Resonance Interference.
anomaly.rewardChoice: your pick: the die «{{name}}» or an engraving voucher
anomaly.interferenceNow: Resonance Interference ×{{n}} is running — any solve clears it.
anomaly.outOfAttempts: No attempts left. Leaving stokes Resonance Interference.
anomaly.locked: {{n}} die is held out of turn 1

codex.title: Codex

glyphLegend.title: School glyphs
glyphLegend.body: Every die carries a corner shape so schools stay apart without colour: Red — triangle · Blue — square · Green — leaf · Yellow — ring · Black — spike · Grey — dot · Prismatic — star.

codex.prologueBody: Replay the opening beats. Nothing is started, nothing is lost.

perk.title: Choose an upgrade
perk.banishHint: Banishing removes that card and its kind from the rest of the run. Once per run.

finale.title: The Core Heart is open
finale.intro: Everything you decided out here is now a door. Only the ones you earned will open.
finale.thin: Echo: "You left it thin, captain. Two doors, both of them shrugging."
finale.deepIntro: There is nothing further to cross. Whatever you carried through the sixth act, this is where it is spent.
finale.thresholdCost: The run continues past the Core. The tide stops being capped, the ending waits until the far side — and the one you pick there will be a deeper telling of it.

setup.title: Launch
setup.ascensionLocked: Clear the campaign once to unlock ascension.

package.title: Gate package
package.voucher: Mk-voucher ×{{n}} — one free upgrade at any shipyard
package.hint: Pick one. The perk draft follows.

place.title: Send a die to a system
place.body: Tap a die, then tap a lit system card — or drag it there. Each card shows what the die will do before you commit, and a die never fits a card whose cap is below its face.

endTurn.title: Resolve the turn
endTurn.body: When the board reads the way you want it, end the turn. Systems fire in the order of the numbers on their cards, then the enemy answers.

reroll.title: Rerolls are free once
reroll.body: Pick any dice still in the tray and reroll them. Rerolls do not carry over between turns — an unused one is wasted.

nudge.title: Charge buys precision
nudge.body: Select a die, then use − and + on the console to move its face by one. Charge pays for it; a free nudge spends nothing.

jump.title: Choose the next node
jump.body: Tap a lit node, then Jump. Fog hides the rows ahead; every Sensors upgrade pushes the horizon further.

targeting.title: Pick what you are shooting at
targeting.body: Tap an enemy to make it the target. Weapons, marks and pierce all land on the target — subsystems are targeted the same way.

reserve.title: Keep a die for next turn
reserve.body: A reserved die skips the reroll and comes back with its face intact. Use it to hold a number the board cannot spend yet.

actives.title: Some dice do more than sit
actives.body: A die with an active can flip, copy, bank or split. The row lights up only for the actives your tray can currently pay for.

resonance.title: Schools reward company
resonance.body: The chips count how many dice of each school the battle holds. Cross a threshold and the whole school gains a bonus for the fight.

affinity.title: The bonus is the slot
affinity.body: A school placed in its own system adds to the face before anything else reads it. That is the sum on the card, and it is free.

prismatic.title: Prismatic counts as anything
prismatic.body: A prismatic die satisfies any school, and in a slot it inherits that slot’s affinity — bonus included. It also counts for resonance.

fate.title: Fate is one roll, once
fate.body: The Fate die never enters a slot. One press, one roll per battle, and the table reads out what it gave you.

motif.title: Sector traits
motif.blessed: Blessed lane: the Choir favours you
motif.unstable: Unstable row: its contents were re-rolled
motif.pocket: Detour pocket: raised risk, raised reward
motif.riftSplit: Rift split: the branches only meet at the gate
motif.inversion: Inverted row: systems resolve last to first
motif.storm: Probability storm: one placed die re-rolls at resolution
motif.blackHoles: Black hole: the cell is gone; its lane offers a wormhole
motif.wormhole: Wormhole edge: a choice waits at the rim
motif.bypass: Skirted the rim: hull scraped by the tide
motif.holeScorch: Hull too thin to pay the toll — the rim let you past

tag.glossaryBody: Tags are how dice, perks, modules and engravings find each other: an effect that counts a tag counts every item carrying it.

axis.title: Axis {{n}}
axis.moves: Black dice push toward Resonance, blue toward Stability; events and drift move it too.

journal.title: Run journal
journal.empty: Nothing written yet. The sector has not asked you for anything.

axis.drift: the deck you actually place moved the axis {{from}} → {{to}}

journal.beaconsHint: The chain is holding. Something at the Core is counting them too.

memory.hintBeacons: Resolve {{n}} beacons in a single run

system.title: Ship menu
system.toMenuHint: The run is saved — pick it up from the menu.

tagDesc.red: Aggression: weapon damage, burn and spikes.
tagDesc.blue: Defence: shields, absorption and staying power.
tagDesc.yellow: Economy: scrap, payouts and shop leverage.
tagDesc.black: Risk: charge, sacrifice and the Resonance axis.
tagDesc.grey: Reading: sensors, dice handling and precision.
tagDesc.prismatic: Wildcard: counts as any school and inherits the slot affinity.
tagDesc.weapons: Anything that resolves in a weapon slot.
tagDesc.shields: Anything that resolves in a shield slot.
tagDesc.engines: Anything that resolves in the engines slot.
tagDesc.sensors: Anything that resolves in the sensors slot.
tagDesc.reactor: Anything that resolves in the reactor slot.
tagDesc.spinal: The spinal mount: one huge shot that wedges on a low roll.
tagDesc.repairBay: The repair bay: hull healed mid-battle.
tagDesc.burn: Damage over time that ticks at the end of the enemy turn.
tagDesc.growth: Values that climb permanently on a max face.
tagDesc.charge: The reactor pool that pays for nudges, rerolls and surges.
tagDesc.scrap: The run currency: shops, repairs and Mk upgrades.
tagDesc.overcap: Placing a die above its slot cap.
tagDesc.pierce: Damage that ignores the enemy shield.
tagDesc.survival: Staying alive: hull, lethal saves and floors.
tagDesc.control: Denying the enemy: jams, locks and gates.
tagDesc.dice: Handling the dice themselves: flip, copy, swap, bank, split.
tagDesc.shieldwall: Stacked shielding that carries across turns.
tagDesc.risk: Costs paid in hull, scrap or certainty.
tagDesc.swarm: Many small dice instead of a few big ones.
tagDesc.spike: One enormous value instead of a steady stream.
tagDesc.precision: Tight, predictable faces and exact values.

hole.title: Black hole
hole.body: The cell is gone. Its rim will either let you around, or take you somewhere it picks.
hole.gentleWhy: The first two rides of a run are short and always go deeper.
hole.bypassFree: Bypass: free — the hull cannot pay
hole.rideCost: Ride: a throw of {{min}}–{{max}}, direction unknown
hole.rideGentle: Ride: a throw of {{min}}–{{max}}, deeper only
